frequency_question: What proportion of attempts to replace expiring transboundary water treaties between contiguous states succeed in signing a new pact within the designated window?
membership_rule: Includes formal bilateral river basin treaties expiring or up for mandatory renewal where renegotiations were initiated; excludes unilateral abrogations or unformalized arrangements.

cases.name: US-Canada Columbia River Treaty regime review
India-Pakistan Indus Waters Treaty modification attempts
Lesotho Highlands Water Project Phase II renegotiations
Senegal River Basin Development Organization protocol updates

coverage_note: 6 named major cases; estimated global universe of similar high-friction renewals is approximately 15.
known_gaps: Under-representation of smaller basin agreements in Africa and Central Asia due to lack of transparent public tracking of expired treaty renewals.
skeleton: Identified bilateral transboundary water renegotiation processes involving federal or sub-national domestic friction points.
multiplier: 4 hits out of 6 documented major structural renegotiation cycles.
validity_reason: Covers the exact temporal horizon of the resolution criteria without structural shifts in international water law.
